# CHANGELOG

## 1.0.0

- Initial release of MockFlow API.
- Automatic REST endpoint generation from JSON schemas.
- In-memory data store with CRUD endpoints.
- Filtering, sorting, pagination, and search capabilities.
- Relational expansions (`many-to-one`, `one-to-one`, reverse lookups).
- CLI commands: `init`, `start`, `generate`, `reset`.
- Full Vitest test suite.
